C9000020.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 020 (Squarefree quartics and power-free polynomial values.; papers: Squarefree values of quartics and power-free values of polynomials; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/020.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_DENSITY.statement: For each locally admissible irreducible integer polynomial of degree 4 through 8, k=d-2 power-free values have the positive Euler-product density (thm:density). This manuscript claim remains unreviewed.

C_LARGE_PRIME_TAIL.statement: For primitive irreducible positive-leading f of degree 4 through 8, the number of X<n<=2X with p^(d-2)|f(n) for some p>X is O_f(X^(1-delta_f)) for some delta_f>0. This manuscript claim remains unreviewed.

C_SIEVE_TRANSFER.statement: The o(X) large-prime tail for the primitive positive-leading part implies the stated positive density for the original locally admissible irreducible f, retaining its exact content-prime local factors. Not audited in this mission.

C_REMAINING_TAIL_INPUTS.statement: The arithmetic, determinant, lattice, Hilbert, quartic geometry, curve and parameter inputs in Sections 4-10 hold with the uniformities required by the Section 11 assembly. These are unresolved obligations outside this mission.

C_AFFINE_COUNTING.statement: Under the exact uniform exceptional-or-Hilbert alternatives of thm:affine-counting, |S| is O_epsilon(X^(sum_h E_h+epsilon)), with no bound on initial defining coefficients. Only its adaptive-prime mechanism is addressed here.

C_RESIDUE_CUT.statement: The full simultaneous residue class on a covered parent satisfying the Hilbert input admits a bounded-degree proper cut when its good-prime product exceeds X^(delta_h+nu), uniformly in the patch (lem:affine-residue-cut). Outside the selected audit.

C_COUNTING_TREE.statement: The residue branching counts, dimension induction, exceptional stopping and exponent accounting in the counting tree give the claimed affine counting bound once the adaptive products and residue cuts are supplied. Outside the selected audit.

C_ADAPTIVE_MECHANISM.statement: The actual evaluation-kernel paths satisfy the finite adaptive deletion theorem and supply a common choice of blocks with sufficient cumulative good-prime products; this does not certify the full counting theorem.

C_ADAPTIVE_FINITE.statement: For all n,ell,T with 1<=ell,1<=T,ell+T-1<=n, the full adaptive bad fraction is bounded by the telescoping mean-record drop plus the harmonic divisor error, hence by (B0-1)/T+D/(n-ell-T+2).

C_ADAPTIVE_SAMPLING.statement: Uniform deletion pairs are in bijection with uniform extension pairs; the deleted subset is uniform and the removed prime conditional on it is uniform in its complement, without stability conditioning.

C_ADAPTIVE_FORMAL.statement: The arbitrary finite regular-incidence edge inequality and all-parameter consecutive-level averaging bound are formalized in Lean, subject to the statement-fidelity boundary.

C_ADAPTIVE_KERNELS.statement: Full evaluation kernels give lexicographically monotone ranks; equal complete mixed-radix records force identical entire paths and minors for the actual deterministic construction.

C_ADAPTIVE_HEIGHT.statement: The actual patch construction gives nonzero integer evaluated minor products of size at most X^K uniformly over points, prime blocks and initial coefficients, for fixed degree limits and fixed length.

C_ADAPTIVE_PRODUCTS.statement: The stated order of fixed constant choices, explicit finite divisor error, Markov and the union bound yield simultaneous regular points and the manuscript's cumulative good-prime threshold at every stage.

C_ADAPTIVE_NO_INDEPENDENCE.statement: Actual rational-line evaluation-kernel paths can target the singleton sampled prime in their Jacobian minor; full-minor independence is not a valid alternative route. This is not a manuscript refutation.
